verdict.rationale: Evidence shows real multi-party involvement beyond Stripe alone: ACP was co-developed with OpenAI ('the first AI platform to implement ACP with ChatGPT'), and MPP was 'co-authored by Stripe and Tempo,' with card networks (Visa's Intelligent Commerce, Mastercard's Agent Pay) also integrated as token issuers. However, participation is still gated ('you'll need to apply' to join ACP/ChatGPT) and most protocols (ACS, UCP) remain single-vendor private previews with no independent third-party implementer named beyond OpenAI/Tempo. Missing for 10: evidence of a third or fourth independent implementer (e.g., another AI platform, PSP, or major merchant building ACP/MPP independently), and community confirmation that adoption exists beyond the two named co-developers.
